settings.serverAddress: Server address, set when building the extension (variable
settings.extensionPrompt:
Install the Leon browser extension from this repository:
1. Build it with WXT_PUBLIC_LEON_URL={serverUrl} pnpm ext:build.
2. In Chrome, open chrome://extensions, turn on developer mode, click “Load unpacked”, and choose the extension/.output/chrome-mv3 folder.
3. Then open the extension options and let me paste my Leon token myself.
